Off the Books: Probably a Farm Story Tweaks 3.2.0
RnK Gaming

WHAT IT DOES
Probably a Farm Story offers every machine you do not own at Dr. Jackson and the Hypertech
Smuggler on every visit. This mod turns that into a chance for each machine and
visit, so a machine becomes something to look out for:
- 25% while you own none of that machine
- 5% once you own one
Research requirements are kept (Cooking: cooking machine and takeaway terminal;
Perfumery: the four perfume machines). Unchanged: the Integrated Farm, the perfume
manual, seeds and recipe notes.

WHAT YOU NEED
Probably a Farm Story. This mod loads after it.

HOW TO USE IT
Nothing to do. Visit Dr. Jackson and the Hypertech Smuggler as usual. Some of the
machines will be missing from their stock on any one visit.

SETTINGS
They are in the Mods list and in Options.
Chance when you own none (%): the chance that a machine you do not own is offered,
from 0 to 100. The default is 25.
Chance when you already own one (%): the chance that a machine you already own is
offered, from 0 to 100. The default is 5. Without this tweak, Probably a Farm Story never
offers a machine you own at Dr. Jackson.

WHAT IT CHANGES
It changes what the two sellers offer, so it changes which machines you can buy.
It writes nothing to a save. The two settings are the only stored values.

REMOVING IT
Delete the mod's folder. Probably a Farm Story then offers its machines as it does without this tweak.

PLAYER.LOG
When a machine is not offered, the game writes its own warning line,
"Destroyed unplaced items: '<machine>' x1 (Farm Story Tweaks: machine not offered this
visit)". This is expected and is not an error. A fault in this mod is reported once
as "[Farm Story Tweaks] a fault in ..." and the game goes on.

TRANSLATIONS
Translations are very welcome: every text is in Localization/en.csv. Send a translated
copy on GitHub: https://github.com/rnk-gaming/probably-stolen-mods/issues
